title: Quick Sort Array - Solution
intuition: Given an array of integers nums, sort the array in ascending order using Quick Sort.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
time_complexity: O(n log n) average, O(n^2) worst case
common_mistakes: Select a pivot element. Partition array such that elements smaller than pivot are left, and larger are right. Recurse.
